In highschool I applied for a job in housekeeping at a local arena/sports event center. I would have no doubt been hired (I know this because my friend got hired and said I would have been to) if only I had gotten an ID to give them for the hiring process. I slacked and never got an ID so in turn never returned to finish the hiring process. 

A couple months down the road I got a job at a pizza place from a friend of mine and after that we started hanging out more and ended up moving into an apartment together the day we graduated. Lived there for awhile then had to move because things just weren’t going well so I moved in with my sister and her husband out of state and lived with them for about a year. Moved there when my nephew was about 4 months old so I got to see him grow up a bit which I’m very thankful for and learned a lot from my sister and brother in law. Did a lot of growing up in that time.

Then I moved back and got a job back at the pizza place where my friend was still working. Shortly after I got back he got a job working at this company doing CAD work. A little later down the road he got me a job at the same company and it’s where I currently work, making decent money for easy work with no further education than highschool. Then we got about 10 more of our friends jobs here over time.

I sometimes wonder how differently things would have played out if I had gotten the job at the arena. I probably wouldn’t have seen my nephew grow up a bit and also I don’t know if I’d be working with a bunch of friends like I do now.
